snippet.title: Fields of Mistria Release Date Trailer | Wholesome Direct 2026
snippet.description: Fields of Mistria, a magical farming and life sim RPG, launches into 1.0 on Steam August 5, 2026! This new trailer reveals first-ever looks at marriage and children, new Saturday Market NPCs, a new home exterior, and even a giant chicken mount. The 1.0 release also brings the conclusion of the Town Repair storyline, along with new quests and features. https://wholesomegames.com/ #summergamefest #wholesomedirect2026 #wholesomedirect
